Definition: from G4314 and G2947; to roll towards, i.e. block against:--roll (to).
BiblicalUsage: Proskylio means to roll something toward, to block against. Joseph of Arimathaea laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb, and rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe that stone was rolled to keep Him in, and three days later it was rolled away to let the world see He was not there.
